reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend (which already handles the daily skip) exactly as getUpcomingDates does.

duplication.why: Repeats the small config.skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date ternary and the null-skip already written in getUpcomingDates rather than sharing a per-occurrence helper.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and clear with a named look-around constant; the weekend-enable ternary is one more copy to keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the shared weekend helper in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated enable ternary is an open copy of the tree's existing call pattern, not reshaped.
